div.div:
PK: Primary Key (UUIDv4 unique ID)
FK: Foreign Key (Referential link)
GIST: PostGIS Spatial R-Tree Index
BTREE: Standard B-Tree Index
1 : N: One-to-Many Relationship
CRS: WGS84 Geodetic (EPSG:4326)
Images decoupled to Supabase Storage
